summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $4.16/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $4.16 a gallon across Wisconsin as of November 1, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 27¢ lower than a week ago, 4¢ higher than a month ago, and $1.49 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Madison ($3.90) and the highest in Mosinee ($4.49).
